Q&A

Momentick delivers quantified, source-attributed emissions intelligence at the asset level, without hardware, site installs, or operational disruption. Our multi-satellite approach provides consistent coverage across complex onshore and offshore infrastructure, giving teams the clarity to prioritize action, strengthen LDAR programs, and reduce financial exposure.


Momentick combines data from multiple commercial and non-commercial satellites and applies proprietary algorithms to deliver asset-level methane quantification with precise source attribution. Our multi-satellite approach reduces data gaps, improves detection confidence, and enables trend analysis over time. We provide consistent onshore and offshore monitoring without hardware deployment, giving operators reliable intelligence that fits directly into existing workflows.

Satellite monitoring provides consistent coverage across complex oil and gas infrastructure without hardware deployment or operational disruption. By combining hyperspectral and multispectral sensors, it enables reliable detection and quantification at the asset level. The result is scalable methane intelligence that supports LDAR programs, operational planning, and prioritized field response.

Fit for purpose monitoring means our approach is tailored to the operational objective. Different use cases require different levels of sensitivity, coverage, and revisit frequency. We align satellite selection and analytics to the specific need of your facility to help you make smarter operational decisions.

Satellite monitoring is designed to complement, not replace, ground-based and aerial inspections. It provides broad, repeatable coverage across dispersed infrastructure, helping identify areas of concern between field visits. Momentick supports LDAR programs and helps teams prioritize where boots on the ground are needed most. Satellite intelligence strengthens existing inspection strategies by adding consistent visibility across onshore and offshore operations.
